description:
Initially unveiled at EVO 2022, a music video to commemorate the 1st Anniversary of "GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE-", animated by studio SANZIGEN. The video, directed by Shinpei Ishikawa, features the theme song Find Your One Way of the main character of the series: Sol Badguy. This music video depicts more than 20 years of the world of Guilty Gear and half his lifetime!

(Source: Arc System Works Twitter, edited)
